prompt: src/report.ts exports renderReport(rows). Given a list of {name, count} rows, return a text table: a header line, one line per row with the name padded to the widest name, and a total line. Skip rows whose count is zero.
why: the worse version does filtering, width measurement, formatting and totalling in one function with accumulator variables; the better one names each step (present, widestName, line) and the top-level function reads as the sequence the task describes
